entries.summary: In this JavaOne keynote, Java Language Architect Brian Goetz takes you inside the process of evolving Java.
entries.text: In this JavaOne keynote, Java Language Architect Brian Goetz takes you inside the process of evolving Java. Through examples spanning lambdas, records, pattern matching, virtual threads, etc., he explores the decisions, constraints, and tradeoffs behind features that feel like they’ve always belonged.
entries.title: Evolving the Java Language: An Inside Perspective

entries.summary: JEP 401 (Value Objects) arrives in OpenJDK as a preview feature, enabling a new Java type model with minimal code changes.
entries.text: JEP 401 (Value Objects) arrives in OpenJDK as a preview feature, enabling a new Java type model with minimal code changes. The talk explains what value objects are, JVM benefits, Valhalla history, implementation details, and the path toward bridging objects and primitives, including future support like List<int>.
entries.title: Why It Takes 3000 Commits to Bring Valhalla’s Value Objects to the JDK

entries.summary: Oracle is pleased to announce Oracle WebLogic Server and Coherence 26!
entries.text: Oracle is pleased to announce Oracle WebLogic Server and Coherence 26! This release brings Jakarta EE 11 support, Java SE 21 and 25 support, new application development capabilities, stronger security defaults, and improvements to data processing, persistence, and operational management.
entries.title: Announcing Oracle WebLogic Server and Coherence 26

entries.summary: We have decided to cease development of Primitive Types in Patterns, instanceof, and switch.
entries.text: We have decided to cease development of Primitive Types in Patterns, instanceof, and switch. The draft JEP https://openjdk.org/jeps/8393282 that would have been the sixth preview of this feature will be withdrawn, and the feature will be removed from JDK 28.
entries.title: Withdrawing the Primitive Patterns Preview Feature
